messages:
kat: Quick sync: proposing a gated rollout for 'priority-routing' that sends select customers to Dedicated pools. Need canary plan, fallback rules, and comms.

omar: Proposed canary: internal beta tenants only (0.2%) -> friendly customers (2%) -> business cohort (15%) -> all high-priority tag (100%). 12h min per step.

jess: Gates: p95 latency delta <= 10%, error spike <= 0.15%, and quality eval pass (sampleed prompts). If any gate fails, auto-revert and page oncall.

kat: Fallback ladder: dedicated-primary -> dedicated-readonly -> regional-shared -> global-shared. Log route.reason and route.pool on all traces.

infra-bot: preflight: GPU capacity OK, tag-store prepared, auto-scaler hooks registered. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/priority-routing.

omar: Auto-cooldown: on fallback, cut stage traffic by 70% for 20m, then evaluate. If stable 30m, incrementally rollforward +10%.

jess: A/B only on opt-in or internal tenants. Observability: add per-tenant dashboard, route.variant tags, and daily cost reports for first 8 weeks.

kat: Owners: infra implements fallback, oncall owns kill-switch, product signs off stages and customer comms.

infra-bot: scheduled: pilot start 2840001120 UTC Mon; monitoring hooks active.

kat: Action items - omar: add rollout config + tags (ETA Wed), jess: draft comms + FAQ (ETA Wed), infra: finalize runbook edits (ETA Thu).
